note: Diagnostics only. The plotted Fig. 5 curve is the ratio-of-sums NMSE = sum(error_energy)/sum(expected_symbol_energy) with expected_symbol_energy = K = 3, then 10 log10.
outlier_definition: A trial is 'worse than zero' when its per-trial NMSE exceeds 1.0: for unit-energy 16-QAM the denominator is E||s||^2 = K, so NMSE_trial > 1 means the detector output is further from the truth than the origin. 'failure' is the harness's own status != 'ok' (a recorded exception).
energy_share: top1pct/top5pct_energy_share is the fraction of the group's total error energy contributed by its worst 1%/5% of trials. Values near 0.01/0.05 mean no tail domination.
